subject: SS
title: Example: Maps and Globes
subtitle: Learn the parts of a map. Then practice and take a short mock test.

blocks.title: What is a map?
blocks.md:
A map is a flat picture of a place.

- A **title** tells you what the map shows.
- A **key** tells you what each symbol means.
- A **compass rose** shows north, south, east, and west.

items.title: Globe
items.body: A round model of the Earth.

items.title: Equator
items.body: An imaginary line around the middle of the Earth.

items.title: Continent
items.body: A very large area of land. The Earth has seven.

blocks.title: Tip:
blocks.md: Find the key first. Then read the map.

blocks.alt: A comic: a girl reads the key on a park map to find the pond.
blocks.caption: Comic 1: read the key first.
